observed_behavior: Named source branches remained at their old tip and HEAD became detached after replay or abort.
expected_behavior: Named sources remain attached and advance on completion; abort restores the original attached source.
causal_mechanism: Passing a commit SHA as the optional Git rebase branch argument detached HEAD before replay began.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Commit identity replaced branch identity at a stateful Git boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The optional branch argument selects attachment as well as the source commit.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Preserve the frozen source attachment while replaying its validated tip.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Omit the optional branch argument after validating current HEAD and attachment; Git uses the current source.

applicability_conditions: Rebase starts on a named source branch
known_non_matches: An intentionally detached source must stay detached.
confirmation_evidence: Attachment assertions failed before correction for clean replay, selected continuation and abort.
regression_proofs: tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: header-only selection replays without planned stops
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: selected multi-commit final hunk stops at each contributor while clean commits replay automatically
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: broadened resolution remains stopped and abort restores the frozen source tip
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: detached source replays without attaching or moving the original branch
